target_customer: Non-technical builders and indie developers who want native iOS and Android apps
problem: Building and publishing native mobile apps is hard for non-engineers.

founders.name: Elvira Dzhuraeva
founders.background_notes: YC page says she led the launch of open source Kubeflow 1.0

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-agent code generation on Expo and React Native with backend and subscription integrations; standard components with hard orchestration.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI app builders exist and generate similar stacks; partnerships such as Adapty help but are replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fastshot is pitched as 'Lovable for mobile apps', so a general builder entering mobile was a known risk; no event found.

market_need_then: Demand for AI app builders was strong in 2025 per press and the company's claim of 10000+ builders (self-reported).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benefit focused; site in seven languages

branding.community_and_virality: Fastshot x Adapty 30 day builder challenge and an Adapty partnership post in Feb 2026

brand_strength.rationale: Simple name, a borrowed positioning line and a partner-run challenge, but no evidence of organic fan community.

outcome_analysis: Fastshot is an active YC Fall 2025 company from Thessaloniki building a no-code mobile app builder, with ex-Google founders and an Adapty partnership. The company claims over 10000 builders, which is unaudited. Funding is aggregator-only and competition from larger vibe coding platforms is intense, so durability is unproven.
notes: Unverified funding: VCBacked, CB Insights and Extruct list 500K pre-seed (Dec 2025) from Y Combinator; Stork says 1M seed. Aggregators conflict; none recorded. Success factor product_led_growth rests on the self-reported 10000 builders and is weak. Competitor search returned only 2026 funding news on Rork; list empty.
